test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the word with the correct spelling from the options given below to fill in the blank.**

They saw the beautiful _______ of the Gods in the Temples.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Idols**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Idols **means images or representations of a god or goddess, which is the correct word to use in the given context. (किसी देवता या देवी की छवियां या प्रतिनिधित्व)
 
• The word is spelled with an "o" and not an "e".
 
• The word is a noun and can be used in the singular or plural form.
 
 
• **For example**: *The idols of Lord Shiva and Parvati were beautifully decorated in the temple.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

**Complete sentence**: *They saw the beautiful idols __of the Gods in the Temples. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• '**Idoles**' is misspelled with an extra "e" with it.
 
• **Ideals **means principles or standards of perfection, which does not fit the context of the sentence. (पूर्णता के सिद्धांत या मानक)
 
• **Idles **means to spend time doing nothing or being inactive, which is not relevant to the sentence. (कुछ न करने या निष्क्रिय रहने में समय व्यतीत करना)
